Individual application

Campus Resource Finder

Working local app · November 2026

A commuter remembers “transit” but types trasnit. The finder suggests Transit Desk and lets the student bookmark it for the next visit.

I chose the commuter workflow and defined what a useful suggestion should do. Codex implemented the Django app and ran the checks. The search shows literal matches first and offers suggestions when those come up empty.

What the checks showed

Six tests passed. All five typo cases returned the intended service in the first three suggestions. A fresh session recovered the saved bookmark. The directory has five fictional services.

Operations analytics

Residence Hall Maintenance

Completed analysis · Synthetic data

Which jobs wait the longest for an owner? I cleaned a simulated residence-life work queue, analyzed assignment times with Python and SQL, and built an Excel dashboard.

Tracking assignment separately from resolution helped distinguish a delay in routing a request from time spent on the repair itself.

What the data showed

In 3,200 source rows, one request ID appeared twice. The cleaned data contained 3,199 requests and averaged 5.58 hours to assignment. I recommended a separate triage queue for urgent work. Its real-world effect is untested.

Group project

Bench & Bolt

Planning draft · Implementation pending

A fictional bike shop needs to track walk-in repair inquiries. A rider who asks for Tuesday should leave with a reference number and know the shop still needs to review the request.

With AI help, I drafted the scope comparison, status rules, and acceptance checks. My proposed build responsibility is intake and validation. The team's proposed second slice is the coordinator's queue and decisions.

What remains to test

The planned team check traces a Tuesday inquiry from its receipt to the queue. Both screens should show the same reference and “Pending review.” The work split awaits team confirmation and the end-to-end check is pending.
